plain: This story is about a man named Michael Herrera, who says that while serving with a military unit in a disaster zone in Indonesia he saw a non-human craft. A guest named Matthew Pines offers a possible explanation: a 'psionic asset' team, people said to have mind powers, was there with the craft, and Herrera stumbled on it, an idea he links to another man, Jake Barber. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, credits the idea to Herrera himself: maybe it was a human trafficking operation moving these psychic people, or a secret programme trying to get out after an earthquake hit. If true, it would mean secret programmes use both craft and gifted people overseas.
